fala_q: Which one is one of the three home activities that use the most water? Drinking a glass of water, Flushing the toilet or Brushing your teeth?
fala_r: Flushing the toilet!

fala_q: Taking a shower. Is it Direct Use or Virtual Use?
fala_r: Direct Use! We can see the water being used.

fala_q: Tommy loves to eat. For breakfast, he eats a banana and what? Chocolate cake, Whole-grain bread or Candy?
fala_r: Whole-grain bread! A banana and whole-grain bread, a healthy breakfast.

fala_q: Broccoli. Healthy or unhealthy?
fala_r: Healthy!

fala_q: Eating a hamburger. Direct Use or Virtual Use?
fala_r: Virtual Use! The water was used to make the hamburger.

fala_q: And what does Tommy drink during the day to help his body? Soda, Nothing or Water?
fala_r: Water! He drinks water during the day.

fala_q: True or false? A camel keeps water inside its hump.
fala_r: False! The hump stores fat, not water.

fala_q: Soda. Healthy or unhealthy?
fala_r: Unhealthy! It has a lot of sugar.

fala_q: Tommy loves candy and soda too. But what should he NOT eat every day? Rice and beans, Candy and soda or Banana and bread?
fala_r: Candy and soda! Only once in a while.

fala_q: Washing clothes. Direct Use or Virtual Use?
fala_r: Direct Use!

fala_q: What unit do we use to measure the water used to produce food? Kilograms, Liters or Meters?
fala_r: Liters!

fala_q: Complete the sentence: fruits and vegetables are examples of what foods? Healthy, Virtual or Desert?
fala_r: Healthy foods!

fala_q: Fish. Healthy or unhealthy?
fala_r: Healthy!

fala_q: What do the camel's wide, padded feet do? Stop it sinking in sand, Let it eat thorny plants or Store fat?
fala_r: They stop the camel from sinking into the sand!

opcoes: Washing the car with a hose
fala_q: Which one of these uses more water? Washing the car with a hose, Using a watering can or Drinking a glass of water?
fala_r: Washing the car with a hose! The water keeps running.

fala_q: Potato chips. Healthy or unhealthy?
fala_r: Unhealthy! A lot of salt and fat.

fala_q: Brushing your teeth. Direct Use or Virtual Use?
fala_r: Direct Use!

fala_q: Rice and beans. Healthy or unhealthy?
fala_r: Healthy!

fala_q: Which one is also one of the three home activities that use the most water? Washing clothes, Watering the plants or Brushing your teeth?
fala_r: Washing clothes! The three are: flushing the toilet, taking a shower or a bath, and washing clothes.

fala_q: Drinking a glass of milk. Direct Use or Virtual Use?
fala_r: Virtual Use! The water that counts was used to produce the milk.

fala_q: A farmer uses water to grow tomatoes. Direct Use or Virtual Use?
fala_r: Virtual Use! The water is used to produce food.

opcoes: Keep sand out of the eyes
Keep sand out of the nose
fala_q: What do the camel's nostrils that close do? Keep sand out of the eyes, Keep sand out of the nose or Store fat?
fala_r: They keep the sand out of the nose!

fala_q: Using a sheet of paper. Direct Use or Virtual Use?
fala_r: Virtual Use! Water was used to make the paper.

fala_q: A factory uses water to make a T-shirt. Direct Use or Virtual Use?
fala_r: Virtual Use! It counts for products too, not only food.

fala_q: What do the camel's thick lips do? Eat thorny plants, Stop it sinking in sand or Keep water?
fala_r: They let the camel eat thorny desert plants without pain!

fala_q: Watering the plants. Direct Use or Virtual Use?
fala_r: Direct Use!

fala_q: How many liters of water to produce one banana? About 160 liters, About 16 liters or About 1,600 liters?
fala_r: About one hundred sixty liters!

fala_q: Which food needs the most water to be produced? Egg, Glass of milk or Hamburger?
fala_r: The hamburger! About two thousand four hundred liters.

fala_q: Buying a pair of shoes. Direct Use or Virtual Use?
fala_r: Virtual Use! It is a ready product.

opcoes: Keeps sand out of the eyes
fala_q: What does the camel's thick fur do? Protects from sun and cold, Stores fat or Keeps sand out of the eyes?
fala_r: It protects the camel from the hot sun and also from the cold desert nights!

fala_q: Which food needs the least water? Tomato, Potato or Apple?
fala_r: The tomato! About thirteen liters.

fala_q: What is an adaptation? A kind of food, A feature to survive or Water we cannot see?
fala_r: A special feature that helps an animal survive where it lives!

fala_q: According to the text, healthy food helps Tommy do what? Eat more candy, Sleep in class or Grow and stay strong?
fala_r: Grow, stay strong and have energy to play soccer with his friends!

fala_q: How many liters of water to produce one slice of bread? About 4 liters, About 400 liters or About 40 liters?
fala_r: About forty liters!

fala_q: Chocolate cake. Healthy or unhealthy?
fala_r: Unhealthy! A lot of sugar and fat.

fala_q: Which usually needs more water: food from animals or food from plants?
fala_r: Food from animals! It needs much more water.

fala_q: How many liters of water to produce one egg? About 135 liters, About 13 liters or About 70 liters?
fala_r: About one hundred thirty-five liters!

opcoes: Keep sand out of the nose
Keep sand out of the eyes
fala_q: What do the camel's long eyelashes and thick eyebrows do? Keep sand out of the nose, Keep sand out of the eyes or Give energy?
fala_r: They keep the sand out of the eyes and shade them from the sun!

fala_q: How many liters of water to produce one glass of milk? About 200 liters, About 20 liters or About 2,000 liters?
fala_r: About two hundred liters!

fala_q: Which is the right order, from the least water to the most? Apple, tomato, egg, Egg, apple, tomato or Tomato, apple, egg?
fala_r: Tomato, apple, egg! Thirteen, seventy and one hundred thirty-five liters.

fala_q: How many liters of water to produce one hamburger? About 2,400 liters, About 240 liters or About 24 liters?
fala_r: About two thousand four hundred liters!

fala_q: How many liters of water to produce one kilogram of beef?
fala_r: Fifteen thousand liters per kilogram! Much more than everything else.

fala_q: Unhealthy food has a lot of what? Water and milk, Sugar, salt or fat or Fruit and vegetables?
fala_r: Sugar, salt or fat!

fala_q: An egg needs about one hundred thirty-five liters. An apple, seventy. How many more liters does the egg need?
fala_r: Sixty-five liters! One hundred thirty-five minus seventy.

fala_q: And milk? Healthy or unhealthy?
fala_r: Healthy!

fala_q: Complete the sentence: we need what to survive? Soda, Candy or Water?
fala_r: Water! We need water to survive.

opcoes: Keep the body off hot sand
fala_q: What do the camel's long legs do? Keep the body off hot sand, Run from lions or Store fat?
fala_r: They keep the body away from the hot sand!

fala_q: True or false? A camel can drink a lot of water at once and go many days without drinking.
fala_r: True! Another adaptation for the desert.

fala_q: This one is worth the grade! The hump stores fat. Why is the fat useful in the desert? Gives energy with no food, Cools the body or Stores water?
fala_r: It gives energy when there is no food! The hump stores fat, not water. If you got this one, you are ready for the test!
fala_s: For the grade... the answer is...
